meta.title: Plugin Discover (GitHub)
meta.description: Adds a Discover tab on the Plugins page: searches GitHub (plus the npm registry) for DeepSeek Harness / Cordis plugins, translates English descriptions to Chinese, groups them by usage category, always includes the newest uploads, and copies an install request you can paste into the chat for the assistant to install.

intro: Searches GitHub (plus the npm registry) for DeepSeek Harness / Cordis plugins, translates English descriptions to Chinese, groups results by usage type, and always includes the newest uploads. Pick one, copy the install request, paste it in the chat.
